note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Group.ReadWrite.All, DeviceManagementConfiguration.ReadWrite.All, DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All, DeviceManagementManagedDevices.PrivilegedOperations.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
# group MG Lab - Intune Users (alex.demo, sam.demo)

$grp = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'MG Lab - Intune Users'").value | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $grp) { $grp = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/groups -Body @{ displayName = 'MG Lab - Intune Users'; mailNickname = 'mglab-intune-users'; mailEnabled = $false; securityEnabled = $true; 'members@odata.bind' = @("https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$(Get-LabUserId 'alex.demo')", "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$(Get-LabUserId 'sam.demo')") } }
# the Windows 11 VM: the lab builder creates CON-W11-01 and stops at Windows setup (needs E:\MGLab\iso\Win11Ent-Eval.iso)
./src/Invoke-IntuneDevices.ps1 -PolicyFile ./src/intune.lab.json -Audit   # off-camera dry run: confirms the VM is listed and consent is in place

screens.name: enroll
screens.app: Hyper-V Virtual Machine Connection (VMConnect) to CON-W11-01, then the Intune admin center in a browser
steps: (Before the screen, once: in the VM's Windows setup choose 'Set up for work or school' and sign in as alex.demo; the owner types the password)
VMConnect, CON-W11-01: Settings > Accounts > Access work or school: the organization connection is listed
Browser, https://intune.microsoft.com/ as labadmin: Devices > Windows
Open CON-W11-01: primary user Alex Demo, ownership Corporate; read the Compliance value as it really is (Not evaluated or Compliant)
Allow a few minutes after the join for the device to appear; do not assume the value
Intune admin center > Devices > Compliance > 'MG Lab - Windows 11 baseline' > Properties
Show the settings as in the file, Actions for noncompliance (Mark device noncompliant after 1 day) and Assignments (MG Lab - Intune Users)

screens.name: device
screens.app: VMConnect to CON-W11-01 (elevated Windows PowerShell as alex.demo) and the Intune admin center
steps: In the VM, elevated PowerShell, type: Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint C:   (show what is real: usually not protected)
Sync: VM Settings > Accounts > Access work or school > the organization > Info > Sync, or on the host: ./Invoke-IntuneDevices.ps1 -PolicyFile ./intune.lab.json -SyncDeviceName CON-W11-01
Intune admin center > Devices > Windows > CON-W11-01 > Device compliance: the real policy state and the failing setting (allow several minutes and a second sync)
In the VM type: Add-BitLockerKeyProtector -MountPoint C: -RecoveryPasswordProtector   (never leave the recovery password on screen)
In the VM type: Enable-BitLocker -MountPoint C: -EncryptionMethod XtsAes256 -UsedSpaceOnly -TpmProtector
In the VM type: Restart-Computer; after the restart and the encryption pass sync again and capture the new compliance state
If a setting stays red for a reason outside the episode, say so on camera instead of editing the policy
mask: device serial and Entra device id
BitLocker recovery password and key id

teardown: foreach ($x in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/beta/deviceManagement/deviceCompliancePolicies?`$filter=displayName eq 'MG Lab - Windows 11 baseline'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/beta/deviceManagement/deviceCompliancePolicies/$($x.id)" }

foreach ($d in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/deviceManagement/managedDevices?`$filter=deviceName eq 'CON-W11-01'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/deviceManagement/managedDevices/$($d.id)"; foreach ($e in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/devices?`$filter=displayName eq 'CON-W11-01'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/devices/$($e.id)" } }

foreach ($g in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'MG Lab - Intune Users'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($g.id)" }   # skip if episode 13 is recorded next

Stop-VM -Name CON-W11-01 -TurnOff -Force; Remove-VM -Name CON-W11-01 -Force; Remove-Item E:\MGLab\CON-W11-01 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # skip if episodes 12 and 13 are recorded next
